title.en: Common multiples and common factors on the number line

text.en: A rabbit jumps 4 at a time and a frog jumps 3 at a time. Both start at 0. Where do they land on the same spot? In the book they first meet at 12.

The rabbit lands on 4, 8, 12, 16 and so on - these are the multiples of 4.
The frog lands on 3, 6, 9, 12, 15 - the multiples of 3.
The numbers that both animals touch are called the common multiples of 3 and 4.
12 is the first common multiple of 3 and 4. The next one is 24. You can keep going on the number line or use the tables of 3 and 4.
Another pair: a spider jumps 3 and a grasshopper jumps 6. They meet at 6 and 12, and again at 18, 24 and so on.
The multiples of 4 are 4, 8, 12, 16 and of 6 are 6, 12, 18. 12 and 24 are common multiples of 4 and 6.
A common factor of two or more numbers divides each of the numbers exactly. 3 is a common factor of 9, 21, 39 and 57. 1 is a common factor of every pair of numbers.
Common factors of 24 and 36 are 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 and 12. A jump of 12 steps from 0 reaches both 24 and 36, and so does a jump of 2, 3, 4 or 6.
The common factors of 12 and 13 are only 1. Notice that the common multiples of two numbers never end, but their common factors are few.

problem.en: Sher Khan the tiger hunts every 3rd day and Bagheera the panther every 5th day. If both hunt today, on which days will they hunt together?

text.en: 15 is in both lists. The next common multiple is 30.

why.en: Common multiples are the days both hunt.

text.en: They hunt together on days 15, 30, 45 ... every 15th day.

why.en: 3 x 5 = 15 because 3 and 5 have no common factor except 1.

prompt.en: Explain how to find the common multiples of 4 and 6.

requiredIdeas.en: Pick the numbers that are in both lists: 12, 24

commonMisconceptions.en: Choosing common factors instead of multiples

points.en: Common multiples are numbers that are multiples of two or more numbers.
The first common multiple of 3 and 4 is 12; the next is 24.
Common factors exactly divide all the numbers; 1 is always a common factor.
The common factors of 24 and 36 are 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12.
